FN-ZX2DWK-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 200
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Randall Shedd
Commissions
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 03/28/2023
House Bill 200 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Historical
Commission until October 1, 2027 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not
otherwise affect state or local funding.
